title: Provider interface parameters
description: Schema for config/templates/<provider>/params.yaml — the provider interface. The `params` block declares every P_* substitution symbol the gitops layer may reference; a provider must supply all of them, and gitops must reference only symbols declared here. P_* symbols resolve from params.yaml only — config.yaml can never define or shadow them. The `infra` block carries Terraform-consumed provider configuration (VM defaults, images, instance shapes) and is provider-shaped by design. Symbols from the design enumeration resolved elsewhere by decision: LB pools and the registry are multi-consumer network facts in config.yaml; the DNS mechanism is the config.yaml dns.provider structural selector; the secrets backend is fixed (in-cluster Vault via ESO) and becomes a symbol only when a second backend exists.

capabilities.description: Structural facts about what the toolkit can deploy on this provider. Unlike params (substitution symbols), capabilities gate Terraform behavior: config-loader preconditions and flux-config Kustomization sets consult them instead of hardcoded provider-name lists. Every provider must state every capability explicitly — absence is not false, it is a schema error.

in_cluster_data.description: True when the in-cluster data layer (hub-data: Percona MySQL/MongoDB operators, Strimzi Kafka, Redis) is packaged and supported on this provider. False forces every data.<store>.mode to external-unmanaged on hub environments.

params.description: Gitops-facing provider symbols. Adding a symbol here is an interface change: every provider must supply it and the reference must exist in gitops.

P_GATEWAY_CLASS.description: GatewayClass name Gateways are bound to (e.g. cilium)

P_STORAGE_CLASS.description: Default StorageClass name workloads should request; empty string means rely on the cluster default. Deliberately UNREFERENCED in gitops today: on proxmox-talos the cluster default (OpenEBS LocalPV) is the decided behavior, and naming a class in workload manifests would rewrite immutable PVC specs on live clusters. The symbol exists so cloud providers can bind it when second-provider validation lands.

P_NODE_ROLE_LABEL_KEY.description: Node label key that carries the pool role (e.g. node-role); label values derive from pool names

P_L2_INTERFACE_REGEX.description: Interface regex for L2 announcements on bare-metal providers; empty string when not applicable

P_KUBE_API_HOST.description: In-cluster Kubernetes API host the CNI targets (Talos KubePrism: localhost)

P_KUBE_API_PORT.description: In-cluster Kubernetes API port the CNI targets (Talos KubePrism: 7445)

infra.description: Terraform-consumed provider configuration (formerly config/templates/mappings/<provider>.yaml content). Provider-shaped; validated by the provider module's own preconditions.
